Shridhar Jare’s journey at 3RI Technologies shows this transition. Through DevOps Classes in Pune, he gained hands-on experience with DevOps tools, worked on projects, completed his certification, and helped prepare for his Quality Engineer role at Shirodkar Preci Comp Pvt. Ltd. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 15, 2026 7:34 pm Shridhar Gahininath Jare’s journey reflects how structured training and practical exposure can help learners prepare for their next professional step. After completing the IIT DevOps course in Pune —Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & DevOps at 3RI Technologies, he developed a hands-on understanding of DevOps and cloud concepts through the training. He was able to improve his technical skills and get ready for chances in the industry with the help of 3RI Technologies’ practical learning method. Later, he started working at Shirodkar Preci Comp Pvt. as a quality engineer. Ltd., putting his learning into the context of a professional work environment. The Challenge Shridhar wanted to take his career forward and knew that he needed to learn more about DevOps. He didn’t want to just study the concepts; he wanted to understand how the tools are actually used in real projects. He was looking for a DevOps course in Pune where he could learn the basics, work on projects, and get a better idea of what the work is really like. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies 3RI Technologies offers a 2-month DevOps course in Pune where you can learn DevOps and cloud concepts through practical sessions and hands-on real-world work. AWS, CI/CD, automation, containerization, Infrastructure as Code, and other DevOps tools are all covered in the course. Along with the concepts, you also get to work on practical labs and projects, giving you a better idea of how these technologies are used in real-world work. The DevOps Training Path in Pune The 2-month DevOps program at 3RI Technologies was structured to move from fundamentals to hands-on implementation, project work, certification, and career support. Week 1: The journey began with DevOps fundamentals, Linux, networking, and cloud computing , building the foundation for understanding modern DevOps environments. Week 2: The focus moved to AWS and Git , covering cloud infrastructure along with source-code management and version control. Week 3: Learners progressed into Jenkins and CI/CD , understanding how code can move through automated build and integration workflows. Week 4: The program introduced monitoring, Ansible, and Terraform , giving practical exposure to configuration automation and Infrastructure as Code. Week 5: The learning moved into Docker and containerization , including working with containers and Docker-based workflows. Week 6: The focus expanded to Kubernetes , covering container orchestration and managing applications in Kubernetes environments. Week 7: The learning came together through hands-on labs and real-time project work , including practical CI/CD workflows using technologies such as Git, Jenkins, AWS, Docker, and Ansible. Week 8: The program concluded with project-based learning, certification, and career-oriented support , including resume preparation, mock interviews, LinkedIn profile guidance, and interview preparation. This structured journey formed part of Shridhar’s preparation as he progressed towards his professional role at SHIRODKAR PRECI COMP PVT LTD . The Outcome of DevOps Classes in Pune The DevOps Classes in Pune at 3RI Technologies combined practical learning, projects, certification, and career support. Key outcomes included: Better Understanding of DevOps: Shridhar got a clearer understanding of DevOps and cloud technologies by learning and working with them during the course. Hands-on Experience: Practical sessions and project work helped him understand the concepts better and see how they are used in real work. Certification: He completed the IIT DevOps – Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & DevOps , which added to his technical qualifications. Interview Confidence: Resume guidance, mock interviews, and interview preparation helped him feel more comfortable while facing job interviews. A Start in the Professional Journey: The knowledge and experience he gained during our DevOps training in Pune helped him take up his current role as Quality Engineer at Shirodkar Preci Comp Pvt. Ltd. DevOps Training at 3RI Technologies Looking for DevOps Classes in Pune where you can learn through practical work and projects? 3RI Technologies offers a 2-month DevOps program covering cloud, CI/CD, automation, containers, and Infrastructure as Code. Along with the technical learning, the program also includes certification and career support such as resume preparation, mock interviews, LinkedIn profile guidance, and interview preparation . As a result, students are better prepared to apply for jobs connected to DevOps and cloud computing.
